CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price

13. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
